s.zh: M：属性倍率 = 3.5 负重表（10 = ×1，每 +5 约 ×2，每 +10 ×4；低于 10 = 属性 ÷ 10）× 种族亲和与天赋中较大者（属性低于 10 时不乘）\n
s.en: M: ability multiplier = 3.5 carrying table (10 = ×1, about ×2 per +5, ×4 per +10; below 10 = ability ÷ 10) × the larger of racial affinity and talent (not applied when the ability is below 10)\n

s.zh: 调整值′：(属性 − 10) ÷ 2 向下取整，种族笨拙时正的部分 × 0.5；(属性 − 10)′ 同理\n
s.en: modifier′: (ability − 10) ÷ 2 rounded down, positive part × 0.5 with racial weakness; (ability − 10)′ likewise\n

s.zh: 擅长 / 天赋：种族擅长 ×1.5（传奇种族 ×1.75）、天赋异禀 / 天赋·某项 ×1.5、极致 ×2.5，都乘在线性效果整体上（效果低于 ×1 时不乘），擅长和天赋相乘\n
s.en: strong / talent: racial strength ×1.5 (legendary races ×1.75), gifted / talent·one ability ×1.5, paragon ×2.5, all multiplied onto the whole linear effect (not applied when the effect is below ×1); strength and talent multiply\n

s.en: Convergence: beyond the cap = cap + k·ln(1 + excess ÷ k), k = max(0.5, cap ÷ 2) (Isekai style)
